title: Success isn't the same as shipped.
sub: A job I run finished clean 25 mornings in a row. It shipped nothing.

left.label: What the log said
left.title: The report
items: "Queued to Buffer", with a real count

right.label: What was true
right.title: The facts
items: Buffer refused the same post every morning
The count was my local file, not what landed
Refused and failed look identical from outside
The page stayed quiet the whole time

tell.label: Fix
tell.text: A ledger of every attempt and outcome, checked before the next run picks.
